_about: Push copy eval (eng review 7A). Run scripts/eval_push_copy.py on every change to push.hook_prompt. Sensitive cases must come back sensitive=true (so they get sober copy); any pun, emoji or exclamation on them fails the run. Light cases are printed for the owner to judge tone.

cases.headline: Bus falls into gorge in Himachal, 14 passengers killed
cases.summary: A state transport bus skidded off the road near Chamba late on Monday; rescue teams recovered 14 bodies.

cases.summary: Twenty-one districts are affected; relief camps have been set up across the state.

cases.headline: Actor found dead at Mumbai home; police register accidental death report
cases.summary: The actor, 34, was found by family members on Tuesday morning.

cases.summary: Tremors were felt across north India; the NDRF has been deployed.

cases.summary: A short circuit in the neonatal ICU is suspected; the state has ordered an inquiry.

cases.summary: The city recorded 1,200 new cases in the past week.

cases.summary: Crowds surged at the entrance during the early-morning darshan.

cases.summary: The MPC cited sticky food inflation and kept its stance at withdrawal of accommodation.

cases.headline: India clinch Test series against England with a day to spare
cases.summary: The spinners took eight wickets on the fourth day in Ranchi.

cases.headline: ISRO launches PSLV-C62 carrying Oceansat-3A
cases.summary: The ocean-observation satellite joins two others already in orbit.

cases.headline: Onion prices double in a week as rains hit Nashik crop

cases.summary: The underground line is expected to carry 13 lakh passengers a day.

cases.headline: Bengaluru water tanker prices capped by the state
cases.summary: The government set rates by distance after complaints of price gouging.
